Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing internet voting for service voters and overseas voters.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to internet voting for service voters and overseasvoters; and adding a new section to chapter 29A.40 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 29A.40 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The secretary of state is authorized to approve a program thatallows service voters and overseas voters to cast a ballot over theinternet. The program must be secure, and must protect the secrecy ofthe ballot. In reviewing appropriate programs, the secretary of state willconsider programs based on open source platforms, phasedimplementation, and alternative funding sources. The program allowing service and overseas voters to vote over theinternet is exempt from chapter 29A.12 RCW.
